title: Highway RE Wall Construction
subtitle: National Highway Corridor, Andhra Pradesh
summary: Full-cycle erection of Reinforced Earth facing panels along an active highway corridor, including geogrid placement, fill compaction, and structural sign-off.
description: This project involves the full-cycle erection of Reinforced Earth (RE) wall panels along a national highway corridor in Andhra Pradesh. Scope includes precision panel lifting via mobile cranes, plumb-and-level alignment setting, geogrid installation at specified vertical intervals, and engineered fill placement with systematic compaction. Stage-by-stage QA/QC documentation and as-built records are submitted prior to handover.

title: RE Panel Precast Facility
subtitle: Centralised Casting Yard, Telangana
summary: In-house precast facility producing M40/M45 grade Reinforced Earth facing panels using precision steel moulds, wet curing, and full batch logging.
description: Our dedicated casting yard in Telangana manufactures high-durability precast RE panels utilizing heavy-duty steel moulds, M40/M45 design mix concrete, and certified rebar cages. Produced panels undergo systematic wet-curing, rigorous quality inspection, structural marking, and organized yard stacking to supply active highway erection sites across South India.

title: State Highway Subgrade Formation
subtitle: Bulk Earthwork & Subgrade Prep, South India
summary: Bulk earthwork, geogrid stabilization, and embankment compaction to bring the state highway formation to design subgrade levels.
description: Comprehensive site preparation covering bulk earthwork, embankment formation, and geogrid reinforcement installation ahead of pavement construction. The site team profiled the subgrade to strict design camber and cross-fall parameters, achieving required dry density standards prior to formal handover to the pavement contractor.

title: Box Culvert Substructure
subtitle: Foundation & Concrete Works, Karnataka
summary: Rebar fabrication, precision shuttering, and structural concrete pouring for a RCC box culvert foundation serving a highway underpass.
description: Execution of foundation structural works for a RCC box culvert beneath an active highway grade separator. The scope encompassed rebar cage assembly per structural drawings, heavy-duty edge formwork, high-grade ready-mix concrete placement using immersion vibrators, and wet curing protocol prior to backfilling.

title: Intersite Structural Logistics
subtitle: Multi-State Heavy Transport Operations
summary: Managed transport of cured RE panels from central casting yards to active construction sites via heavy trailers and crane fleets.
description: End-to-end supply chain management transporting heavy precast concrete elements from primary casting yards directly to installation faces. Operations include route clearance, low-bed multi-axle trailer dispatching, site crane mobilization, offloading, and site stockyard sequencing to support installation schedules.

title: Underpass Deck & Wing Wall Structures
subtitle: Highway Underpass Execution, Andhra Pradesh
summary: Reinforcement steel fixing, specialized formwork, and monolith concreting for a vehicle underpass slab and adjacent wing walls.
description: Turnkey construction of deck slab and retaining wing walls for a vehicle underpass. Our structural execution team managed rebar cage assembly, precision timber/steel shuttering, stage-wise concrete pours, surface finishing, and compliance testing at every stage.

title: NH-40 Expressway Corridor
subtitle: Walajapet / Ranipet to TN/AP Border (28.02 Km)
summary: Casting and erection of approximately 2.75 Lakh Sq. M. of Reinforced Earth wall panels across a 28.02 Km stretch of NH-40.
description: Comprehensive execution of Reinforced Earth (RE) wall panels along a 28.02 Km stretch of the NH-40 4-Lane Access-Controlled Expressway Corridor (Walajapet/Ranipet to TN/AP Border, Design Chainage Km 106+800 to Km 134+821). Scope includes precision panel casting at dedicated facilities, logistics management, crane deployment, and site erection across an estimated 2.75 Lakh Sq. M. total area.
